sentences.text:
Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Umesh Kumar Mishra, Advocate  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Ajay Mishra, APP  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE HARISH KUMAR  ORAL ORDER 2 11-12-2024 Heard learned Advocate for the petitioner and the learned APP for the State.
2.

The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Udwantnagar P.S. Case No. 572 of 2022 registered for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 and 120(A) of the Indian Penal Code.
3. The allegation against the petitioner is of procurement of appointment on the post of Panchayat Teacher on the basis of forged and fabricated Matriculation certificate/mark-sheet.

4. Learned Advocate for the petitioner contended that though with effect from 06.12.2022, the petitioner has not been allowed to mark his attendance, however, till date neither any show-cause notice has been served to the petitioner Patna High Court CR.

MISC. No.81826 of 2024(2)
dt.11-12-2024 nor any departmental proceeding has been initiated.
5. In order to verify the contention, as noted in paragraph no.10 of the bail application, learned Advocate for the State prays for a short adjournment.
